misses.description: two OCR settings over one colour-dropped image are not independent readers: on stamped scans both read the same wrong digits (X1-N10 amount due 1,656.25 as 7,656.25; X1-N18 VAT total 1,225.00 as 7,225.00; X1-N06 VAT total 0.00 as 0.90), turning abstentions into false FAILs
the legal window dropped two pointer words in KB01 and handed the check a shorter passage; a shorter passage is easier to find verbatim
X1-N17 (two-column page): OCR read 'Per:' as 'Peer:', so the line rows disagreed with the text layer and a born-digital page lost its decision
CT15 and CT17: the text layer could not locate the quotation because pdfjs rows interleave the opinion's columns
CT13: OCR inserted a stray '|' into the quotation, so a correct PASS was lost
presence checks pass on agreed garbage: X1-N03's issue date read as 'AN 7-11-13', and the template placeholder '#issue_date#' passes BR-03 (C16, C17, C19 moved to PASS on it)
